title: Member Number 009
text: “Committing atrocities to enrich oneself, eliminating those who displease you, attempting to violate others—these are the merciless acts of those who have fallen to evil. Even if those in power permit such things, someone will always rise to punish the unforgivable. That, people call justice!”
“…I wonder if Naofumi-san taught her that strange line. She’s probably picked it up from some anime or another.”

Perched atop the clock tower with the sun at her back, arms crossed, Fleon-chan—now in her costume-change form—descended gracefully to stand as a shield before Riska and the others. Humming a tune, she timed her dramatic entrance to the rhythmic beat of Rafuemon’s drumming, I say.
“Oink!”
“What the hell are you!? State your name! Coming to a place like this, you’re asking for a beating!”
“An emissary of justice from the sky! Behold, Magical Fleon has arrived! I’ve already captured solid evidence of what you were about to do! Now accept your punishment with dignity!”
“Shut up! Everyone, let’s go!”
“Right!”
“Oink!”
In a flash, Fleon-chan chanted a spell, flapping her wings at the students who were readying their attack magic, and conjured countless flames with a single beat of her feathers, indeed.
“Magical Fleon, Zweite Feather Fire!”
“Gwaaaah!?”
“Wha—too fast!”
“Oiiiink!?”

The magic they’d unleashed was blown away by Fleon-chan’s spell, and instead her flames struck the pigs and the male students, setting them ablaze. Writhing in pain, the pigs rolled about while the boys scrambled frantically to put out the fires.
“Still want more!?”
Fleon-chan sparkled, brimming with fighting spirit, I say.
“What’s going on?”
“Whoa! That’s Magical Fleon-chan over there!”
Drawn by the commotion, uninvolved students began to gather.
“Getting cocky, are you!? Hey! Let’s teach her a lesson!”
Just as the students who’d extinguished the flames turned toward her with fury in their eyes, ready to act—
“No, that won’t be necessary.”
In a flash—shubababa!—Itsuki appeared, having just dropped an Arrow Rain that landed a hair’s breadth from striking both the ill-mannered students and the pigs.
“Oh! It’s Perfect Justice-san!”
“That’s not my name in this loop. Fleon-san, your part is over, so please go home now.”
“Oh no, my role is far from over! As long as evil exists in this world, my heroic deeds shall never cease!”
Fleon-chan continued shadowboxing while humming to herself—shu, shu, I say.

“In any case, I’ve clearly witnessed what you all attempted to do to Rishia-san and the others. I’ll be reporting this incident to the academy, so please accept the consequences accordingly. Otherwise, you’ll face even harsher punishment.”

With that, Itsuki gave a stern warning to the pigs and the delinquent students, then escorted Riska and the others away. Apparently, after repeating this kind of intervention several times, those who tried to directly harm Riska vanished from the scene in record time.
Meanwhile, at the very moment Itsuki was capturing all this on film, I say—I was walking through the academy grounds after having marched the pigs off to the discipline teacher.

“Whooaaa! Fleon-chan coming to the academy is the absolute best! I was planning to hand in my research materials quick and head to Zeltoble to watch the Filolial races and cheer for Yuki-tan, but I say, this humble servant has decided to keep coming here for a while yet!”
Oh?
“So that’s the Filolial the Hero raised that’s been the talk of the town? She really was a gorgeous girl.”

“That’s right! Let me tell you, that’s Magical Fleon, otherwise known as Fleon-chan! A flying Filolial thought to be extinct, raised by the Spear Hero-sama himself, and she’s such an earnest girl who wants to fight for justice alongside the Bow Hero-sama, I say!”
Well, well, quite the enthusiastic scholar we have here, I say. Perhaps I should join in on the conversation myself.
“My, what a delightful conversation you’re having.”
Naturally, in my young lady mode, I say. I slipped into the conversation where the enthusiastic student was speaking and checked the source of the voice. Oh? This one… I remember this one, I say.
“Ah, Moto-san. Hello.”
I don’t know the other student he was talking to, but I certainly recognize the one who was so passionately discoursing on Fleon-chan.
“Well now, aren’t you Filolial Honor Guard Number… Zero-Zero-Nine! Doctor, I presume!”

Indeed, in the very first world, this was the figure known as Doctor, the one who single-handedly developed all manner of cheering merchandise for the Filo-tan Fan Club 009. Dressed in a lab coat like Doctor herself, sporting slightly curled glasses, with the temperament of a true researcher—an ardent devotee of Filolial-sama, I say! I remember every single face among the fan club members. Especially since, no matter which world it is, the founding members always gather together, and I make certain to assign each of them their designated number without fail, I say. And of course, even at the underground live event held at Father’s gathering—Father who had given his very body over to Rival—Doctor was there too, I say!
“I—is that so? Um, Moto-san?”
The bystander student, evidently suspicious of my sudden change in tone, calls out to me, but there’s no need to concern ourselves with such trifles, I say.
“Oh? You know my member number? Just who might you be, then?”
“Member Number 00! Motoyasu Kitamura, I say!”
I switch off my microphone and address Doctor in my own natural voice, I say.

“Oh! That voice—could it be the Chairman!? Well now… I’d heard the Bow Hero would be attending, but to think even the Chairman himself would grace us with his presence—what remarkable disguise skills! This microphone… ah, I recognize it now. It’s the item commissioned for research in Faubrey, I say.”

Incidentally, her speech pattern bears quite a resemblance to my own, I say. And this voice-changing microphone was indeed Doctor’s own creation. Truly, she seems to be quite the talented one—not a genius of lies like Takt, but a proper, dedicated engineer in the same vein as Doctor herself. Given how Filolial-sama has gotten along so well with her throughout our cheering activities, there can be no mistake about it, I say.
“Then is Yuki-tan accompanying you as well? This humble servant cannot help but hold out hope, I say.”
“Regrettably, Yuki-chan is far too busy with her races to participate in this particular mission, I say.”
“Ah, what a shame, I say.”
“Well, meeting like this must be some kind of fate. Once it’s time for the race, I’ll see to it you get there, I say.”

“Oh! That would be an enormous help, indeed! When this humble servant told his parents he wished to go watch Yuki-tan’s race, they insisted he at least submit his research materials to the academy first, and so I’ve been forced to miss several races already, I say.”

Incidentally, Doctor should technically also be a fan of Filo-tan, but in this particular loop, Filo-tan is Sakura-chan, and while Sakura-chan does play around with her Fiancée, she doesn’t really sing or dance much, so her recognition rate remains rather low, I say.
“Wait, Motoyasu Kitamura… Moto-san is the Spear Hero!? But the Spear Hero’s supposed to be a guy!?”
The bystander lets out some cry of astonishment, I say. Well, can’t be helped—time to crack my shoulders wide and switch costumes, I say.
“Will this convince you now?”
“Ohhhh… something about this feels deeply unsettling. I might start assuming every pretty girl is secretly a dude now.”
The bystander student staggered away, turning his back on us, though I continue the conversation regardless, I say.
“So Doctor turned out to be a student here after all. Since I’d made it a rule not to pry too deeply into such matters, I never knew, I say.”

“Just like Rishia, who’s at the center of this whole incident, this one has already completed all the required credits, I say. Doctor is a researcher specializing in Magic Alchemical Engineering, I say.”
Hmm, hmm… well, I never knew that either, I say. Our relationship had generally been limited to the occasional request for cheering merchandise, after all.

“As a fellow researcher, this one finds herself rather fascinated by that golem, Rafuemon, who came to the academy. To respond so fluently, it must have been crafted by quite the master artisan. The people in my department were making quite a fuss about it, I say.”
Kyu
